notes:
Overview: Stratos builds a JetBrains-focused IDE copilot plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm). Primary differentiator is a hybrid local-index + cloud-model approach: local repo symbol index for instant, semantically accurate completions; cloud LLM for synthesis and multi-file suggestions. Key quote from CTO: "We cannot risk sending raw repo snapshots to a third-party without encryption + explicit retention controls."

Requirements (high level): local index snapshots per workspace, optional on-host lightweight inference for sensitive projects, low-latency streaming for sub-60ms token starts in editor completion, model/version pinning per customer (some enterprise customers require pinned quantized 4-bit variants), deterministic rollouts for beta channel. Deep integration with IntelliJ PSI to preserve symbol resolution when offline. Strong audit trails + ability to purge indices on demand.

Commercials: interest in Dedicated or Private for enterprise accounts; hosted API OK for early users if data residency + KMS enforced. Pricing sensitivity around per-active-developer meter; target contract size $60k-$150k ARR for initial rollout.

Sales notes: AE intro -> demo plugin with sample monorepo; security review in parallel; POC includes perf benchmarks (latency/throughput) and legal review for index ownership. Customer is worried about compatibility with upcoming IntelliJ 2024.3 EAP and wants a small pilot on PyCharm first.

Callouts: customer wants explicit SDK hooks for streaming completions in the plugin, ability to fallback to a smaller hosted model when Dedicated pool saturated, and a simple API for snapshot encryption keys (bring-your-own-key). They asked: "Can we pin a quantized model per-team and still use hosted fallback?" AE said yes in principle, need to show rollout plan.

Short-term goal: validate end-to-end POC with 10-15 devs, measure completion latency and token cost.

Long-term: offer Stratos-managed plugin in JetBrains marketplace with Redwood-backed inference (dedicated pools) and an option for customers to run private control plane on-prem.
